caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. The bonnet has a semi-cylindrical shape with a slightly flared opening. Its outer surface is rendered in a woven texture and colored olive green, while the inner lining appears to be a light gray shade. There is a wide, gray ribbon attached at the back of the bonnet, tied into a bow with long, trailing ends. The shadowing emphasizes the three-dimensional form and fabric folds of the ribbon. At the lower right of the drawing is the signature “D. Cline” in small, green text. The overall composition is centered, with the bonnet and ribbon occupying the middle of the otherwise empty background.
title: Doll's Straw Bonnet
